title: 🏛️ SEBI Market Reforms — SWP/STP in Demat, AIF Exit Flexibility & ETF Price Bands
executiveSummary: SEBI proposed allowing standing instructions for Systematic Withdrawal Plans (SWP) and Systematic Transfer Plans (STP) for demat mutual fund units.
masterKeyFacts: SEBI proposed allowing standing instructions for Systematic Withdrawal Plans (SWP) and Systematic Transfer Plans (STP) for demat mutual fund units.
SEBI proposed reducing Z-score for historical stress testing in commodity derivatives from 10 to 5, revising Core Settlement Guarantee Fund coverage to top 3 defaults.
SEBI proposed allowing AIFs to retain funds beyond permissible fund life for ongoing tax/litigation demands with 75% investor consent by value, capped at 3 years.
SEBI proposed shifting ETF base price from T-2 closing NAV to T-1 data/iNAV with dynamic price bands (10-20% equity/debt, 6-20% gold/silver, 5% overnight).
SEBI mandated AIFs to upload scheme-wise NAV data at ISIN level directly to depositories within 30 days.
